*<https://github.com/relias-engineering/rlms-website/pull/501|#501: feature/RPLAT-9497: permissions implemented>*

Converts permission checks from synchronous boolean to async observables with proper permission validation for course creation UI controls.

*✅ Overall Assessment*

Well-structured PR with good test coverage and proper RxJS patterns. Changes correctly implement permission-based UI controls.

*🔴 Critical Issues*

None identified. Implementation follows Angular best practices.

*🟡 Medium Issues (4)*

• Memory leak risk - verify subscription cleanup with takeUntil
• Missing error handling on permission observables
• UI flash due to default false value before observable emits
• 80 lines of commented-out feature flag tests

*🟢 Nitpicks (4)*

• Inconsistent import formatting
• Verbose test naming conventions
• Empty PR description
• Mixed assertion styles (toBe vs toBeNull)

*💡 Recommendation*

✅ Approve with minor suggestions for error handling and test cleanup
